about_the_game:
The JASON Walkthrough Module is an optional extension designed to support you throughout your playthrough without ever breaking immersion.
It can be enabled or disabled at any time from the preferences menu, and offers two contextual aids that remain discreet and only appear when you need them.

  • Localization Aid: when points of interest are available on screen, a button will light up. With a single click, all active hotspots will be revealed so you don’t miss anything.

  • Choice Aid: during key decisions or in free roam phases, a button allows you to open an information window. It provides:

    • a reminder of the current narrative context,

    • useful details to better understand your options,

    • in free roam: a list of available main actions, their duration, and their potential impact on the story ahead.

The Walkthrough is designed to guide you only if you want it: you can enjoy the full challenge and discovery without ever opening it, or call upon it when you feel stuck.
